title: Massive protests after 22-year-old student found dead at homestay; 'lover' detained
description: Nimisha Thakuria, a 22-year-old sociology student, was found dead at a homestay in Dharapur. Her alleged lover, Ashiq Ali, has been detained by the police for questioning. Reports indicate that they had stayed at the homestay multiple times before the incident occurred. Residents staged a protest demanding a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding her death. Police have sent the body for a post-mortem examination as they explore various angles.

title: Rumours of ghost & ‘missing girls’ spark night-long protest at university in Punjab
description: Students at a private university in Rajpura protested due to false rumours about missing female students. The unrest began after a prank led to ghost stories linked to a supposed suicide. Police confirmed that no students were missing and that the reports were unfounded. The crowd clashed with police and vandalized vehicles during the protest. Authorities are investigating the source of the rumours while assuring that academic activities remain unaffected.

He criticized the prospect of additional seats for Western countries like Germany and Japan, linking it to the West's military actions in Ukraine, which he argues undermine core principles of the UN.

This extra income has been instrumental in alleviating her farm debts following her husband's passing. Even though the turbines occupy less than an acre, she continues her traditional farming practices on the bulk of her land. The rise of wind power is transforming the financial prospects for rural landowners nationwide.

title: Girl started lemonade stand with $10 goal; 7 summers later, sisters raised $55,000
description: Grace Hendrian and her sister June initiated their Lemon-Aid Stand for Good in 2019 to support charity. They aimed to raise $10 but ultimately collected $55,000 for The Salvation Army. Their project encouraged community participation, leading to 14 stands operating by 2026. The sisters received recognition for their volunteer efforts as they also contributed to local families in need. Their fundraising initiative concluded in 2026, marking its final season.

title: NASA sent 12.5 million tomato seeds to space; later planted across 40,000 schools
description: In 1984, NASA initiated the SEEDS project aimed at exploring how the space environment affects plant growth. Participants, comprising approximately 3.3 million students from diverse educational backgrounds worldwide, received kits that included seeds launched into space and Earth-based controls for comparison. Preliminary findings indicated a marginally enhanced germination rate for the seeds sent to space, though notable growth differences diminished during the plants' life cycles.

title: Harassed, complained, forced to quit: Employee's viral post
description: In a powerful recount, Ritica detailed her decision to resign after encountering workplace harassment, met with inadequate responses from management. Despite reporting the incidents to HR, her cries for help were dismissed, leading to even more obstacles, including pressure toward her coworkers to file complaints against her. Ultimately, she felt compelled to leave, convinced that the situation would remain unchanged.

title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.
